brief: Square root of the sum of squares
description: Return the square root of the sum of the squares of the <dataType> values, as ECMAScript Math.hypot does, without overflow or underflow in between. At least one value is required (ECMAScript's hypot() is 0); an infinite value makes the result Infinity. A result that would be NaN, or a NaN argument, is an error. An integer is not accepted: write to_double(v).

errorsThrown.reason: the result would be NaN, or an operand is NaN
